note: Bird Branch (teen numbers minus ones, no borrow). English only. Teaching has no question, so the 1s pauses are beats before the next action. Type A (fly) = a*_a describes the flock then reuses how_many as the question. Type B (branch) = b*_q, pick the branch that shows the total. Type C (take) = c*_q tells how many birds to shoo away, then reuses how_many. Runtime shuffles the ten questions and every option set.

lines.text: Look at the birds. One ten and eight ones make eighteen.
Five birds fly away from the ones branch.
We take away the ones. Eight minus five equals three.
So, eighteen minus five equals thirteen!
When we take away, the ten stays the same.
There are sixteen birds. Four fly away.
There are seventeen birds. Five fly away.
There are eighteen birds. Three fly away.
There are fifteen birds. Four fly away.
Find the branch with eighteen birds.
Find the branch with sixteen birds.
Find the branch with thirteen birds.
